_comment: Product brief. Copy to <slug>.json and fill. Anything left null is OMITTED from the page rather than invented — see PIPELINE.md 'Truth rules'.
name: Product Name
tagline: The one-line benefit, not the feature.
category: beauty | home | wellness | tech | pet | outdoor

economics._note: sellPrice in the $20-40 impulse band converts best. Target 3x+ on landed cost.

source._note: Real listing data only. Null if unverified.

trend._note: momentum 0-100. Only fill from real research; cite sources.

positioning.problem: The specific frustration the buyer feels today.
positioning.agitation: Why the usual workaround fails them.
positioning.demoIn3s: What the camera shows in the first 3 seconds.
positioning.buyer: Who they are, in one sentence.

reviews._RULE: REAL reviews only, quoted from the actual supplier listing or your own customers. Never invent testimonials or ratings — fake reviews are illegal in the US (FTC) and will get a store shut down. Leave empty until you have real ones.

guarantee.text: 30-day returns. If it does not do what this page says, send it back.

shipping.estimate: Add the honest estimate. Do not promise 2-day on a 14-day supplier.

cta._note: Point at the real checkout URL.

media._note: Local paths or data URIs. Null falls back to generated abstract art rather than misleading stock photography.

legal._note: Health/beauty claims need care. No medical claims. No 'cures'. No before/after implying guaranteed results.
